steps: Existing physics source opens a dedicated editor. Adding a body does not create a scene instance; an empty instance ID fails validation, removal restores the original identities. Incomplete numeric input stays visible and clears approval/diagram. Rust-checked circle and offset changes review without author or draft writes.

At 390px, Chinese, English and Japanese preserve the exact input element, focus/selection, reviewed source and approval. Return, Check, Apply and Cancel remain visible and the final field can scroll into view. Confirmed Cancel preserves all author bytes and the original editor draft.

Apply changes only the ordinary unsaved draft. Reopening reads that draft and Cancel retains it. Normal Save writes exactly the reviewed source, preserving BOM, CRLF, escaped root key, unchanged numeric spelling and unchanged body slices; metadata, scene and other author files remain byte-identical.

GUI Plan, Build and real Godot headless Run consume the saved circle radius 12 and local offset X 2. Character stops at x≈131; actual sensor enter/exit publishes the other instance UUID from its sensor binding. Animation completes idle/action/idle under unchanged project protocol 10.
